title: Microsoft Sentinel

header.html: Describe security information and event management (SIEM) and security orchestration automated response (SOAR); Describe how Microsoft Sentinel provides integrated threat protection; Describe threat detection and mitigation capabilities in Microsoft Sentinel
the official SC-900 study guide, skills measured as of October 21, 2026

toc.title: Integrated threat protection: the four jobs

html:
1SIEM and SOAR

Term Stands for What it does
SIEM Security information and event management Collects and analyzes security data from many sources to detect threats
SOAR Security orchestration, automation and response Automates responses to alerts and incidents with playbooks

Microsoft Sentinel is Microsoft's cloud-native SIEM and SOAR solution. It is built on Azure, so it scales without servers to manage, and it is now part of the Microsoft Defender portal experience. [Verify live]

Exam tip

. SIEM = collect, correlate, detect. SOAR = automate response. Sentinel does both. It is not an endpoint antivirus; it uses data from Defender products.

2Integrated threat protection: the four jobs

Job How Sentinel does it
Collect Data connectors bring in data from Microsoft services (Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Defender), Azure, on-premises, other clouds and third-party products
Detect Analytics rules find threats; machine learning and User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA) spot unusual behavior; threat intelligence matches known bad indicators
Investigate Incidents group related alerts; the investigation graph shows entities and relationships; hunting searches proactively
Respond Automation rules and playbooks (built on Azure Logic Apps)

Data is stored in a Log Analytics workspace and queried with Kusto Query Language (KQL).

Exam tip

. Sentinel ingests data through data connectors, including from Microsoft Defender products, Azure and third parties.

3Threat detection and mitigation

Capability Meaning
Data connectors Ingest logs from many sources
Workbooks Dashboards and visualizations of the data
Analytics rules Scheduled or near-real-time queries that create alerts and incidents
Incidents A collection of related alerts to investigate as one case
Hunting Proactive searching with KQL before alerts fire; bookmarks save findings
Notebooks Use Jupyter notebooks for advanced analysis
Threat intelligence Match logs against known malicious indicators
UEBA Baseline normal behavior to flag anomalies
Automation rules and playbooks Respond automatically: block a user, isolate a device, open a ticket, notify a team
Content hub Ready-made solutions: connectors, rules, workbooks, playbooks

Exam tip

. Workbooks = see. Analytics rules = detect. Incidents = investigate. Hunting = look proactively. Playbooks = automate (Logic Apps). Everything is queried with KQL.

4Exam Q&A

4.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Fabrikam Outdoors wants one cloud-native service to collect security logs from many sources, detect threats and automate responses. Which fits?

  • AAzure Bastion
  • BAzure Key Vault
  • CMicrosoft Sentinel
  • DMicrosoft Entra Connect
Show the answer

Answer: C. Sentinel is a cloud-native SIEM and SOAR.

S2Which Sentinel feature automates a response, such as blocking a user, when an incident occurs?

  • AWorkbook
  • BData connector
  • CBookmark
  • DPlaybook
Show the answer

Answer: D. Playbooks, built on Azure Logic Apps, automate responses.

S3An analyst wants to search proactively for suspicious activity before any alert fires. Which capability is this?

  • AHunting
  • BWorkbooks only
  • CIncident closing
  • DSecure score
Show the answer

Answer: A. Hunting uses queries to look for threats proactively.

S4What does a Sentinel incident represent?

  • AA single database table that stores one log type
  • BA user license that unlocks Sentinel features
  • CA collection of related alerts to investigate together
  • DA network security rule that allows or blocks traffic
Show the answer

Answer: C. Incidents group related alerts into one case.

S5Which language is used to query data in Microsoft Sentinel?

  • ASQL only
  • BHTML
  • CKusto Query Language (KQL)
  • DYAML
Show the answer

Answer: C. Sentinel queries Log Analytics data with KQL.

S6Which term describes automating response to security alerts?

  • ASOAR
  • BCSPM
  • CDLP
  • DSSPR
Show the answer

Answer: A. SOAR is security orchestration, automation and response.

4.2 Recall questions

R1What does SIEM stand for?

Show the answer

Security information and event management.

R2What does SOAR do?

Show the answer

Automates responses to alerts and incidents.

R3What brings data into Sentinel?

Show the answer

Data connectors.

R4What do workbooks provide?

Show the answer

Dashboards and visualizations.

R5What are playbooks built on?

Show the answer

Azure Logic Apps.

R6Where is Sentinel data stored?

Show the answer

In a Log Analytics workspace.

5Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
SIEM and SOAR collect, correlate, detect; automate response
Sentinel jobs collect (connectors), detect (analytics, UEBA, threat intelligence), investigate (incidents, hunting), respond (playbooks)
Tools workbooks, analytics rules, incidents, hunting, notebooks, content hub; KQL; Log Analytics
